ns2:course.label: Introduction to Hydrogeology
ns2:course.description: (GEOL 355) Introduction to environmental and economic aspects of the occurrence and movement of groundwater through the earth's crust; topics include the hydrologic cycle, groundwater contamination, petroleum migration, formation of mineral resources, and groundwater chemistry. Prerequisite: MATH 220, concurrent registration in CHEM 104 and CHEM 105 or CHEM 204 and CHEM 203 or consent of instructor.
